sections.callout: Q4 2025: diluted EPS of $0.95, up from $0.21 a year earlier.

footnotes: Fourth quarters (Q4 2024, Q4 2025) have no 10-Q: they are the full year in the 10-K less the nine months in the third-quarter 10-Q.
Cash flow figures are reported year-to-date; each quarter is the year-to-date total less the previous quarter's. Free cash flow = operating cash flow − purchases of property and equipment.

Diluted EPS is not additive across quarters. Where the filing gives no three-month EPS (fourth quarters), it is calculated as net income to common ÷ estimated diluted shares (the full-year weighted average × 4 less the nine-month average × 3), and may differ from the reported figure by a cent or two.
The company reports no cost of revenue line, so net revenue flows straight to operating expenses.
The company reports no operating income line; pre-tax income is shown instead.
Revenue = net interest income + noninterest income.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding. QoQ compares with Q3 2025; YoY with Q4 2024.
